title: Packs for the client: download and preview only, or may the product send them?
bluf: Narrowed: the feedback half is settled (your 29 Sep route-A ruling: submissions become a Jira issue and an email to you; the pre-engagement wording stays placeholder through HP's review, ruled 23 Oct, hpsmpoc-pre-engagement-pack-wording-1023 b). One question is unruled (HPSMPOC-91): your 29 Sep words asked for the ability to send collateral to the client; the three packs are built as download and preview only, with nothing sent unless you rule otherwise. Recommend: keep download and preview only for the POC. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-91

options.label: Download and preview only for the POC
options.detail: Nothing emailed to a client by the product.

options.label: Allow the product to send packs to clients
options.detail: Needs a separate decision and a design.
